description: CodeSupply aggregates and curates comprehensive software metadata, including origin and licensing information, security vulnerabilities, and quality metrics from distributed, authoritative data sources across programming ecosystems and software typesusing an open source data license.
 We are seeking project proposals between 5.000 and 50.000 euro's that deliver additional FOSS components.

Our grants are primarily for technical development.
Our EU-supported funds require a strong European dimension; usually this means applicants should (mostly) be from Horizon Europe-eligible countries.
